name: Pesto Chicken and Cauliflower Bake
ingredients_verbatim: Fresh basil (cut into ribbons for garnish - optional)
why: Pure oven bake (roast cauliflower, fold in pre-cooked shredded chicken breast + mozzarella, coat in pesto-cream, bake to bubbling) bound by cheese and pesto, no rice/pasta/potato/bread. Published 563 cal / 11.8g carbs / 41.7g protein per serving sits mid-to-upper band and is very high protein for the calories. Weigh-and-divide scales cleanly to 14. All mains map to the Omaha board: cauliflower, olive-oil, cooked-shredded-chicken (or chicken-breast), pesto, heavy-cream, shredded-cheese/mozzarella. Distinct Italian flavor from existing cauliflower bakes (jalapeno-popper, bacon-ranch, bacon-broccoli) - pesto-mozzarella is not a duplicate.
